parameters.name: HighSpaceUsageProtection
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to unconditionally clean up binary logs when the instance storage usage is 90% or higher, or the remaining storage is less than 5 GB. Valid values:
- 1: enabled.
- 0: disabled.

parameters.name: LocalLogRetentionHours
parameters.description: The number of hours for which log backups are retained locally. Valid values: 0 to 168 (7 × 24). A value of 0 indicates that log backups are not retained. Default value: 18.

parameters.name: LocalLogRetentionSpace
parameters.description: The maximum space usage of binary logs, in percentage. Valid values: 0 to 50. This is a loop space. Default value: 30.
